Symbols:
  \Theta^{\otimes}: fraction of surface sites of type \otimes (surface coverage) [-] (computed)
  K_{H_2}: adsorption equilibrium constant for H2 on reduced surface sites (parameter)
  p_{H_2}: partial pressure of hydrogen (variable)
  \Theta^{*}: fraction of reduced surface centers that are free (unoccupied) relative to total reduced surface centers [-] (computed)
  K_{H_2O}: equilibrium constant for adsorption of H2O on a surface site [bar^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{O}: adsorption equilibrium constant for atomic oxygen (parameter)
  p_{H_2O}: partial pressure of water vapor [bar] (variable)
  K_{CO_2}^{*}: adsorption equilibrium constant for CO2 on a * site (parameter)
  p_{CO_2}: partial pressure of CO2 in the gas phase (variable)
  K_{CH_3OH}^{*}: equilibrium adsorption constant for methanol [bar^{-1}] (parameter)
  p_{CH_3OH}: partial pressure of methanol (variable)
  K_{P1}: equilibrium constant for the CO hydrogenation reaction (CO + 2 H2 ↔ CH3OH) expressed in terms of partial pressures (computed)
  T: process temperature [K] (variable)
  K_{P2}: equilibrium constant for reaction P2 [-] (computed)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  - Catalyst deactivation neglected; only reactions (1)-(3) considered.
  - Langmuir‑Hinshelwood mechanism with adsorption, surface reaction, desorption.
  - Oxidized centers (⊙) are active for CO hydrogenation.
  - Reduced centers (∗) are active for CO₂ hydrogenation.
  - Total numbers of oxidized, reduced and hydrogen centers are constant.
  - Fast steps are at quasi‑equilibrium.
  - Quasi‑equilibrium assumption for fast adsorption/desorption steps.
  - Lumped kinetics for reactions (1)-(3).
  - Two alternatives for φ: quasistatic (Eq.22) or dynamic (Eq.28).
